title: Paul on Sexual Immorality and Church Discipline in Corinth
description: Paulus reacts strongly to reports that a man in the church at Corinth is living with his father's wife, an immorality not even found among pagans. He instructs the church to remove the sinner from their midst and hand him over to Satan for the destruction of the flesh, so that his spirit may be saved on the Lord's day. Paulus uses the image of leaven that permeates the whole dough to urge the church toward purity, reminding them that Christ is their Passover lamb. He clarifies that they should not associate with anyone called a brother who lives in immorality, greed, idolatry, slander, drunkenness, or robbery—not even to eat with such people. Those outside the church God will judge.
